# lambda-trigger-scheduler

Creates an EventBridge Scheduler schedule that invokes a Lambda function on a recurring or one-time basis, with support for timezones and flexible time windows.

## Usage

```hcl
module "daily_report" {
  source = "../../modules/lambda-trigger-scheduler"

  function_name = module.my_function.function_name
  function_arn  = module.my_function.function_arn

  schedule_name       = "daily-report-9am"
  schedule_expression = "cron(0 9 * * ? *)"
  timezone            = "America/New_York"
}
```

## IAM Model

This is a **push-based** trigger. EventBridge Scheduler assumes an IAM role to invoke Lambda.

The module creates a dedicated role with minimal permissions:
- `lambda:InvokeFunction` on the target function
- `sqs:SendMessage` on the dead-letter queue (if `dead_letter_arn` is configured)

## Inputs

### Required

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `function_name` | `string` | Name of the Lambda function. Used for resource naming. |
| `function_arn` | `string` | ARN of the Lambda function. |
| `schedule_name` | `string` | Name of the schedule. |
| `schedule_expression` | `string` | Schedule expression: `rate(5 minutes)`, `cron(0 12 * * ? *)`, or `at(2024-01-01T00:00:00)` for one-time. |

### Optional

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `description` | `string` | `null` | Description of the schedule. |
| `schedule_group_name` | `string` | `"default"` | Name of the schedule group. |
| `timezone` | `string` | `"UTC"` | Timezone for the schedule (e.g., `America/New_York`, `Europe/Paris`). Any IANA timezone is supported. |
| `flexible_time_window` | `number` | `0` | Flexible time window in minutes. Set to `0` for exact time (OFF). Values above `0` allow Lambda to be invoked within a window, reducing thundering herd issues. |
| `start_date` | `string` | `null` | Start date in ISO 8601 format (e.g., `2024-01-01T00:00:00Z`). Schedule won't trigger before this date. |
| `end_date` | `string` | `null` | End date in ISO 8601 format (e.g., `2024-12-31T23:59:59Z`). Schedule won't trigger after this date. |
| `enabled` | `bool` | `true` | Whether the schedule is enabled. |
| `input` | `string` | `null` | JSON-encoded input to pass to the Lambda function. |
| `retry_policy` | `object` | `null` | Retry policy configuration (see below). |
| `dead_letter_arn` | `string` | `null` | ARN of the SQS queue for dead-letter (failed invocations). |
| `kms_key_arn` | `string` | `null` | ARN of the KMS key to encrypt the schedule. |
| `tags` | `map(string)` | `{}` | Map of tags applied to all resources. |

**`retry_policy` object fields:**

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `maximum_event_age_in_seconds` | `number` | `86400` | Maximum time to keep an unprocessed event (1 min to 24 hours). |
| `maximum_retry_attempts` | `number` | `185` | Maximum retry attempts (0 to 185). |

## Schedule Expression Formats

| Format | Example | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `rate()` | `rate(5 minutes)` | Run every N minutes/hours/days. |
| `cron()` | `cron(0 9 * * ? *)` | Cron expression (minute, hour, day-of-month, month, day-of-week, year). |
| `at()` | `at(2024-06-01T12:00:00)` | One-time schedule at specific datetime. |

## Outputs

| Name | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `schedule_arn` | ARN of the EventBridge schedule. |
| `schedule_name` | Name of the EventBridge schedule. |
| `role_arn` | ARN of the IAM role used by the scheduler. |
